title: Web3Yak Domain Studio
tagline: 🚀 The ultimate platform for companies to unleash their web3 domain potential. Empower your brand, innovate, and connect like never before.
description:
Introducing Web3Yak Domain Studio, the revolutionary solution for companies seeking complete control and security over their domain names. Say goodbye to the hassle of creating individual use cases for domain names. Our platform empowers companies to sell or mint domain names with customized pricing and images using our seamless WordPress plugins.

With Web3Yak, companies can stay within their own website ecosystem while enjoying the benefits of a Web3 domain. Our system ensures that wherever a domain is minted, it seamlessly integrates with the Web3Yak ecosystem. This eliminates the need for additional domain execution work, saving time and effort.

What's more, companies can leverage our platform to create unique logic and applications that automatically work for other domains within the Web3Yak network. Unleash your brand's potential and stay ahead in the web3 revolution with Web3Yak Domain Studio.
how_its_made:
Web3Yak has taken a two-fold approach to enable companies to mint their own subdomains and streamline the process. First, the platform has deployed a smart contract responsible for creating web3 domain names and managing associated records. This ensures a secure and decentralized environment for domain creation and management.

To facilitate the minting of subdomains matching their brand names, Web3Yak is developing WordPress plugins. These plugins will provide a seamless integration within the WordPress ecosystem, allowing companies to easily configure and customize their subdomains. The configuration process will involve specifying the desired top-level domain (TLD) name, which can be obtained from Web3Yak's platform. Companies will also have the ability to set the price for their subdomains and provide an NFT image URL associated with each subdomain.

Once the configuration is complete, the WordPress plugins take over the handling of the rest of the process. They automate the subdomain minting, ensuring that the desired subdomains are created according to the specified TLD, price, and image URL. This automation simplifies the workflow for companies, eliminating the need for manual intervention and streamlining the overall experience.

By developing these WordPress plugins, Web3Yak aims to empower companies to have complete control over their subdomains, making it easier for them to align their branding and maintain a cohesive online presence within the web3 domain ecosystem.

Technology used:
WordPress + IPFS + NFT.Storage + FVM
